scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "cyan,blue" "npm run dev --prefix apps/api" "npm run dev --prefix apps/web"
scripts.dev:api: kill-port 4000 || true && npm run dev --prefix apps/api
scripts.dev:web: kill-port 3000 || true && npm run dev --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:api && npm run typecheck:web
